description: Identifies the Habiro element [2]_q·(1-h²α) of the empirical α_EM next-order term (#1511) with the categorical 1-loop self-energy diagram on M_Bring: closed fermion loop in the fundamental SU_q(2) representation. Verifies [2]_q = J_2(unknot) (colored Jones at N=2 of the trivial knot), the structural origin of the (1-h²α) Schwinger factor from 2-vertex Hecke quadratic, and the reuse of dim H¹(M_Bring) = 8 in the 8π = π·dim H¹ normalization. Does NOT do full RT shadow-world calculation; identifies the categorical object whose Habiro element matches the empirical form.

categorical_identification.fundamental_q_dim_equals_colored_jones: [2]_q = J_2(unknot) verified symbolically and numerically at q_0
categorical_identification.Schwinger_factor_origin: (1 - h²α) from 2-vertex Hecke quadratic σ² = hσ + 1 insertion times α coupling at each photon-matter vertex; minus sign from antisymmetric singlet channel parity
categorical_identification.normalization_origin: 8π = π · dim H¹(M_Bring) = π · 2g at g=4; same dim H¹ used in n=2 leading 2/(3π) shift = dim H¹/Area — structural consistency across Bloch levels
categorical_identification.habiro_taylor_coefficients_exact: c_k^{[2]_q} = 2 · C(1/2, k/2) · (1/4)^(k/2)  (binomial, even k); c_k(α) = c_k^{[2]_q} - α · c_{k-2}^{[2]_q}  (Schwinger shift); all rationals exact, full closed form via binomial series of √(1+h²/4) per PR #1511
